issues: The SRO regime is reported as 2200–2500 K, with calculations fixed at 2260 K, not 2000–2400 K.
The 12×12×12 supercell was used for an MTP free-energy/MD step, not identified as the MTP training-cell size.
The reported MTP RMSE is 2.6 meV/atom for GGA-PBE, not below 1 meV/atom; 1 meV/atom is a target free-energy accuracy.
The approximately 20-fold speedup is relative to original TOR-TILD, whereas the 80% resource saving is relative to hybrid TOR-TILD; they are not equivalent comparisons.
The 0.5 meV/atom FEP-versus-TI comparison is shown for TaVCrW, not the VW benchmark, and compares MTP-to-DFT corrections rather than FEP against 'TI using EAM.'
The 48 K electronic effect is a melting-temperature shift; the corresponding electronic Gibbs-energy difference is 4.2 meV/atom.
The boundary description understates the caveat that ordinary spin-polarized tests were negligible but more sophisticated treatment of magnetic fluctuations may still matter.
